key: The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work, On the stream’s loud-resounding bank.
s: Midway through a hymn to Agni, the verse speaks in numbers; Sāyaṇa, on 8.61.7, reads the seven as priests milking the one gharma, a pot of boiling milk, and two of them, the adhvaryu priests, as directing five others, the sacrificer among them.

evidence.words: “सप्त ऋत्विजः “एकां घर्मं “दुहन्ति । तेषां मध्ये "द्वा द्वौ प्रतिप्रस्थातारावध्वर्यू “पञ्च अन्यान् “उप "सृजतः प्रयोजयतः । के ते पञ्च त उच्यन्ते । यजमानं ब्रह्माणं होतारमाग्नीध्रं प्रस्तोतारमिति । … is explained as the gharma, or earthen vessel so called, which is used to boil milk
evidence.gloss: The seven officiating priests milk the one gharma. Among them the two adhvaryus, the pratiprasthātṛ and the adhvaryu, set five others to work, employ them. Who are those five? The sacrificer (yajamāna), the brahman, the hotṛ, the āgnīdhra and the prastotṛ. … (Wilson, note 1, explaining Sāyaṇa’s gharma:) the earthen vessel so called, used to boil milk.
